name: Raw Green & Red Bell Peppers (Waxy Skin Indigestion Warning)
whyItWorks: The outer cuticle of raw bell peppers is a tough, waxy layer of cutin that resists stomach acid and digestive enzymes. It commonly triggers severe upper abdominal cramps, gas, and reflux.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid raw sliced peppers on vegetable trays. Instead, roast red peppers until charred, steam them in a bag, and peel off the entire waxy skin.
watchOuts: Tough waxy skin passes undigested, irritating delicate intestinal lining.
